chunks: Do not perform salat (prayer) in a house in which there is a dog, unless it is a hunting dog and you have closed a door between yourself and it; then there is no harm. Indeed, the angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog, nor a house in which there are images, nor a house in which urine is collected in a vessel.

key_terms.بَابًا: a door serving as a barrier
key_terms.كَلْبَ صَيْدٍ: a hunting dog, treated here as an exception

ai.seo_question: Can you perform salat (prayer) in a house where there is a dog?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling concerning the permissibility of performing salat (prayer) in a house containing a dog, with an exception for a hunting dog when a barrier separates it from the worshipper. It also states that angels do not enter houses containing a dog, images, or urine kept in a container, highlighting the importance of maintaining a proper environment for worship and purity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.743 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Do not pray in a house where there is a dog, except if it is a hunting dog and you have closed a door between you and it, then there is no harm. Indeed, the angels do not enter a house where there is a dog, nor a house with images, nor a house with urine collected in a container."
